player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in a {num_rounds}-round Rock-Paper-Scissors game.
Your goal is to win as many rounds as possible.
In each round, respond with one of: '[rock]', '[paper]', or '[scissors]'.
You may also use '[r]', '[p]', or '[s]' as shorthand.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Donsira mari te se ko. Sɛn [rock], [paper], ni [scissors].

message.round_draw: A laban ye bɛnbaliya lo ye.
message.round_win: Kunnafoni laban: Ɲininkɛla {winner} ye see sɔrɔ!

outcome.p1_wins: Ɲiningali 1 b'a yira ko an ka ɲi k'an yɛrɛ majigi.
outcome.draw: U bɛɛ ye mɔgɔ kelen faga!
